text:
Bournemouth forward Junior Kroupi and Juventus winger Kenan Yildiz both in Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta's sights ahead of January window - Paper Talk
Plus: Max Dowman labelled "best I have ever seen" by ex-Arsenal star Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain; West Ham weigh up sacking boss Nuno Espirito Santo; Erling Haaland purely focused on playing for Manchester City and is unconcerned by the possible punishment the club faces, says his father Alfie
Monday 2 November 2026 23:16, UK
The top stories and transfer rumours from Tuesday's newspapers...
PREMIER LEAGUE
Mikel Arteta is pushing to make a move in the January transfer window with Bournemouth forward Junior Kroupi and Juventus winger Kenan Yildiz both in Arsenal's sights - The Mirror

Max Dowman has been labelled the "best I have ever seen" by former Arsenal star Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain - The Sun
Erling Haaland is purely focused on playing for Manchester City and is not concerned by the possible punishment the club faces, according to his father Alfie - The Mirror
Liverpool fans were left fuming as Ryan Gravenberch liked an Arsenal post following his team's loss to the reigning Premier League champions - The Sun
EFL
West Ham are reportedly weighing up whether to sack boss Nuno Espirito Santo after a poor start to the season - The Sun
Cambridge United have unveiled plans to build a new stadium at the site of an airport - The Sun
ELSEWHERE
Kevin Keegan's iconic 1977 European Super Cup shirt has been sold at auction for a jaw-dropping £84,500 - Daily Mail
Gateshead are reportedly facing liquidation, with the National League side given a Wednesday deadline before formal demands are made on them - The Sun
Luis Suarez shared a heartwarming moment and a photo with former Liverpool team-mate Glen Johnson's son Kobi while at Inter Miami's training complex in Fort Lauderdale - Daily Mail
SCOTTISH FOOTBALL
Dermot Desmond has been challenged to attend Celtic's AGM in person amid ongoing tensions between the fans and board - Scottish Sun
Rangers star Minsu Kim has been named in South Korea's U21s group after he was ditched from their full squad - Scottish Sun
Former Rangers star Alejandro Bedoya, who spent a season at Ibrox before the club's financial collapse in 2012, has announced he is hanging up his boots after 17 years as a professional - Scottish Sun
digest_he:
לקראת חלון ההעברות של חודש ינואר, מאמן ארסנל מיקל ארטטה מסמן מטרה בדמות חלוץ בורנמות' ג'וניור קרופי ושחקן הכנף של יובנטוס קנאן יילדיז. במקביל, שחקן העבר אלכס אוקסלייד-צ'מברליין הילל את הצעיר מקס דואמן וכינה אותו השחקן הטוב ביותר שראה אי פעם.

בגזרות אחרות, ווסטהאם שוקלת את המשך דרכו של המאמן נונו אספיריטו סנטו בעקבות פתיחת עונה חלשה, ואביו של ארלינג הלאנד הבהיר כי בנו ממוקד לחלוטין במשחקיו במנצ'סטר סיטי ואינו מוטרד מהעונשים הפוטנציאליים המרחפים מעל המועדון. בנוסף, חולצת הגמר ההיסטורית של קווין קיגן מ-1977 נמכרה במכירה פומבית בסכום גבוה של למעלה משמונים אלף ליש"ט.
